game_title: Discount Rules – Coral Reef Shallows Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, a new sea charts challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of sea charts by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 50 seconds.
